title: 第一卷 第6章 副镇长，杨德民！
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

杨德民看着跑到跟前的闫耀宗，稍稍皱着眉，问道：“小同志，现在雨这么大，路不好走吧？”

“不好走！”迎上杨德民的目光，闫耀宗点头道，“路上很多村庄都被淹了。领导，我想问问，那些被淹村庄的村民……他们现在还好嘛？”

“都还好，政府前几天就组织人手，把那些地势低，容易被淹的村庄村民，接到镇安置所。”杨德民解释道。

“那就好、那就好！”闫耀宗长松一口气。

闫振东跟着挤出人群，一步两三个台阶，跑到闫耀宗身后，有点儿心虚的看着杨德民跟晁建国。

这两人一看就知道是‘领导’，耀宗居然有胆子喊住他们，跟他们聊天……

“小同志，你们上闫村地势高，应该没有洪灾吧？”杨德民问道。

“回领导，上闫村确实没有洪灾。不过，村子里的存粮不多了。还有，现在村子里的井水都被淹。我们喝的水，虽然都煮过，可依然不干净。领导，我跟我同伴这次来卫生站，就是想要买些黄连素、大蒜素胶囊、蒙脱石散，还有84消毒液。”

杨德民挑了挑眉，闫耀宗的话，倒是提醒了他，那些还没被淹的村子，粮食跟水源，确实是个大问题。

杨德民看向晁建国，道：“晁站长，你给这位小同志拿些药物，至于钱，就挂在镇政府的账上。”

“好的，杨镇长！”晁建国连忙答应。

说到这里，杨德民又看向闫耀宗，道：“至于粮食……现在道路难走，粮食难运……”

杨德民确实很脑壳疼，现在暴雨倾盆，很多道路都被冲垮，想要运送粮食，简直就是困难重重。

“领导！镇里不是有个大型修理厂嘛？如果可以，领导能不能给我开个条子，让我购买两个淘汰下来的汽车内胎？”闫耀宗小声问道。

汽车内胎？

杨德民眼睛一亮。

镇里大型修理厂淘汰下来的汽车内胎可不少。

平日里，很多人都会从修理厂购买淘汰下来的内胎，打上气，当做游泳圈。

闫耀宗的话，倒是点醒了他。

现在路难行，不是不能走。

粮食难运，可以把内胎绑起来，当做运输工具。

“小同志，你叫什么名字？”杨德民笑着问道，心里边已经有了打算。

“回领导，我叫闫耀宗！”

“好名字！”杨德民笑着伸手拍了拍闫耀宗的肩膀，道：“你刚刚的话，倒是给了我一些想法。修理厂那边，等下我打个电话过去，你直接去拿两个内胎。至于粮食，政府肯定不会坐视不管…最多三天，肯定会运一批粮食到你们上闫村！”

“谢谢领导、谢谢领导！”闫耀宗连忙弯腰鞠躬道谢。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Yang Demin looked at Yan Yaozong who ran up to him, frowned slightly, and asked: "Little comrade, it's raining so hard now, isn't it difficult to walk on the road?"

"It's not easy to walk!" Meeting Yang Demin's gaze, Yan Yaozong nodded and said, "Many villages on the road have been flooded. Leader, I want to ask the villagers in the flooded villages... are they okay now?"

"Everything is okay. The government organized manpower a few days ago to bring villagers from villages with low terrain and easy flooding to the town resettlement centers." Yang Demin explained.

"That's good, that's good!" Yan Yaozong breathed a sigh of relief.

Yan Zhendong squeezed out of the crowd, ran up two or three steps at a time behind Yan Yaozong, and looked at Yang Demin and Chao Jianguo with a little guilt.

These two people were immediately known to be ‘leaders’. Yaozong actually had the guts to call them and chat with them...

"Little comrade, your Shangyan Village is on high ground, so there should be no floods, right?" Yang Demin asked.

"Back to the leader, there is indeed no flood in Shangyan Village. However, there is not much food in the village. Also, the well water in the village is now flooded. Although the water we drink has been boiled, it is still not clean. Leader, my companion and I came to the health station this time just to buy some berberine, allicin capsules, montmorillonite powder, and 84 disinfectant."

Yang Demin raised his eyebrows. Yan Yaozong's words reminded him that food and water sources were indeed a big problem in those villages that had not yet been flooded.

Yang Demin looked at Chao Jianguo and said, "Stationmaster Chao, get some medicine for this little comrade. As for the money, it will be on the town government's account."

"Okay, Mayor Yang!" Chao Jianguo agreed quickly.

Having said this, Yang Demin looked at Yan Yaozong again and said: "As for food...it is difficult to walk on the road now and it is difficult to transport food..."

Yang Demin really has a headache. There are heavy rains now and many roads have been washed away. It is simply difficult to transport food.

"Leader! Isn't there a large repair shop in the town? If possible, can the leader write a note for me to buy two obsolete car inner tubes?" Yan Yaozong asked in a low voice.

Car inner tube?

Yang Demin's eyes lit up.

There are quite a lot of car inner tubes that have been discarded from the large repair shops in the town.

On weekdays, many people buy discarded inner tubes from repair shops, inflate them and use them as swimming rings.

Yan Yaozong's words woke him up.

The road is difficult now, not that it is impossible to walk.

If food is difficult to transport, inner tubes can be tied up and used as transportation tools.

"Little comrade, what's your name?" Yang Demin asked with a smile, already having a plan in mind.

"Go back to the leader, my name is Yan Yaozong!"

"What a name!" Yang Demin smiled, reached out and patted Yan Yaozong on the shoulder, and said, "What you just said gave me some ideas. Over at the repair shop, I'll call you later, and you can go directly to get two inner tubes. As for food, the government will definitely not sit idly by... In three days at most, a batch of food will be shipped to your Shangyan Village!"

"Thank you, leader, thank you, leader!" Yan Yaozong quickly bent down and bowed to express his thanks.
